decision: Retain original-source retrieval/readout and provenance/owner-review infrastructure as the development base; defer the native CUPMem writer and automatic semantic reconsideration for ordinary use.
entrypoint: examples/practical_service.py --strategy simple (all other required flags still apply)
runtime_default_note: The measured implementation is frozen. Its constructor default remains cupmem; callers must choose simple explicitly. The CLI already requires an explicit strategy.
retained: Immutable originals with source identity, owner and timestamps
One-call cited original-source reader, within measured input limits
Pending proposals and explicit original-owner review
Headless Python/JSONL contract and real-model example
deferred: Native CUPMem writes as a prerequisite for all QA
Long-document general support under the current whole-record input expansion
rationale: No supported reconsiderations under the frozen strict rubric in either arm
Native writes add ingestion cost and can block content-correct QA
Zero strict QA regressions coexists with low absolute quality and lost content-only answers
Literal citations and authorization checks do not establish semantic correctness
next_failure_to_address: Bound evidence context without cutting subject/action/condition and decouple original-source QA availability from failed derived-memory writing.
scope_complete: Implementation, fixed evaluation, and adoption decision; performance acceptance failed and the broader research problem is not solved.
